config.simpleenddragonfight.title: Simple End Dragon Fight
config.simpleenddragonfight.enabled.tool: Turns the whole module on or off (with SimpleBuilding also its switch Enable Simple End Dragon Fight). Default: on.
config.simpleenddragonfight.raiseBaseHea: On: the dragon has 300 health per counted player; off: the Vanilla 200 per player. Default: on.
config.simpleenddragonfight.maxPlayers.t: Most players that add a health bar; 0 = every player counts. Default: 0.
config.simpleenddragonfight.countCreativ: Creative players count as well (spectators never do). Default: off.
config.simpleenddragonfight.leaveGraceSe: A player who leaves the island, dies or disconnects keeps counting this long before the dragon loses the bar. Default: 60.
config.simpleenddragonfight.islandRadius: Horizontal distance from the exit portal within which players count. Default: 160.
config.simpleenddragonfight.speedMultipl: Flight speed and turn rate of the dragon in its flying phases. Default: 1.2.
config.simpleenddragonfight.speedPerPlay: Added to the speed for every further player. Default: 0.015.
config.simpleenddragonfight.crystalHealS: End crystals heal in proportion to the larger health. Default: on.
config.simpleenddragonfight.mitesEnabled: From half health the dragon calls Dragonmites near the exit portal. Default: on.
config.simpleenddragonfight.miteBase.too: Dragonmites per wave for one or two players. Default: 2.
config.simpleenddragonfight.miteExtraPer: One more mite per wave for every two further players. Default: 1.
config.simpleenddragonfight.maxAliveMite: At most 8 + players living Dragonmites, never more than this. Default: 16.
config.simpleenddragonfight.animationEna: Portal ring, rising dragon, growl with a shock ring and sparks for every player who enters the fight. Default: on.
config.simpleenddragonfight.animationTic: Length of one entry animation. Default: 60.
config.simpleenddragonfight.maxQueued.to: Most waiting entry animations; beyond that the oldest is dropped. Default: 16.
config.simpleenddragonfight.exposeSpawnE: Shows the Dragonmite spawn egg in the creative tab. Default: off.
config.simpleenddragonfight.summonScalin: Every further dragon summoned with End crystals adds this share to health, damage and speed, for good (world-wide count). 0 = off. Default: 0.15 (+15 %).
config.simpleenddragonfight.summonSpeedC: Highest total flight speed once summonings add to it. Default: 2.0.
